summary.en: Hardware-focused VC (founded 2015) investing in servers, autonomous vehicles and IoT/new mobility. Has raised three funds totalling ~US$73M (~US$60M deployed) across 16 startups including autonomous-trucking firm Plus, NVIDIA-acquired DeepMap, GaN player Navitas and mobility startup Whill. Leverages Taiwan's electronics supply chain; transitioned toward syndicate investing in early 2024.

name.local: 和泰集團 x StarFab 加速器

aka: 和泰 x StarFab 加速器

strategy.thesis: Mobility-focused corporate accelerator run by Hotai Group (Toyota's Taiwan distributor) with StarFab, helping AI startups build the future of MaaS / smart mobility — vehicle connectivity, smart mobility applications, smart manufacturing and warehouse management — via real-scenario validation across Hotai's MaaS, iRent, yoxi, Vehicle Beauty and Toyota Material Handling units.

perks: POC with Hotai MaaS, 和泰聯網, 和雲行動, 車美仕, 和泰豐田物料運搬
program.eligibility: Startups in AI enablement, data governance, smart vehicle connectivity, vehicle connectivity / smart mobility, smart manufacturing and warehouse management

application.how_to_apply: Apply online at the program page during annual call

summary.en: Mobility-focused corporate accelerator launched in 2024 by Hotai Group (exclusive Toyota distributor in Taiwan) together with StarFab, to co-build the future of MaaS and smart mobility. The program gives AI startups de-identified data, physical venues and digital platforms for real-scenario POCs with Hotai's mobility subsidiaries; its first year drew nearly 100 applicants. Phase 2 (2025) expanded into vehicle connectivity, smart mobility, smart manufacturing and warehouse management.
summary.local: 由和泰集團(Toyota 台灣總代理)與 StarFab 於 2024 年成立、聚焦智慧移動的企業加速器,共創 MaaS 與智慧移動未來。提供 AI 新創去識別化數據、實體場域與數位平台,於和泰旗下移動事業進行真實場景概念驗證(POC),首年吸引近百家新創報名;第二期(2025)擴大至車聯網、智慧移動、智慧製造與倉儲管理領域。
